alex: Morning — async canary standup for infer-v3 rollout. Quick status: rolled infer_v3 to 3% last night (slice=safety-2). Ran smoke load overnight.
What I did: rolled canary, sanity smoke, collected p95/p50 traces.
Blockers: seeing occasional 429s for long-context (>1024 tokens) requests on a single host. Pattern looks like KV-cache evictions under burst. Error rate ~0.2% (still under 0.5% threshold) but 429s spike in small windows.
Today: 1) correlate 429s -> host heatmap, 2) test increasing kv_cache_size on canary pool, 3) coordinate warmup with SRE and prep FF toggle.

maria: thanks. can you paste the exact feature-flag name and current percent? also what's the fallback policy if errors go up? :thumbsup:

jonathan: FYI i pushed a short circuit in routing that will fallback to infer_v2 if p50 > 800ms for 5m. flag is `routing.rollback_guard` (off by default). I left a note in the PR with how to enable.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] canary/infer-v3 ramp event: ramped to 5% for slice=safety-2 at 1719023600 — metrics pipeline started.

tony: seeing a customer report for req id `req_9f3b2c` hitting a 429 around 03:14 UTC. logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/req_9f3b2c — looks like long-context + repeated retries. can you check server-side evictions?

alex: grabbing logs now. initial glance shows kv_cache eviction spikes on host ip 10.32.8.14 around the same timestamps. will run a targeted repro with the same payload and post results.
ETA ~45m.

maria: ok, if you see correlated evictions and error window > 0.5% we should hit the FF kill-switch. i'll stand by to schedule 10% ramp at 17:00 PST if stable.

alex: agreed. i'll post a short summary + recommendation here by 1719023890 (final call). tagging @jonathan @tony for any routing/metric zv checks.
